nature: Evidence-mutation negative controls for the checker oracle, one or more per review counterexample. They do not add, remove or widen any original22 process control or expected outcome set, and are not supplemental matrix cases until Main admits them.
execution: None performed or authorized. No fixture generator exists in this group; a Main-approved harness would have to build each otherwise-satisfying base bundle. Until then, each result stays NOT_EXERCISED and must not be counted as evidence.
pass_rule_if_ever_exercised: Each case passes only when the candidate returns verdict FAIL, exits 1 and reports the named mechanism. Any other outcome, including exit 2 or a different Invalid message, is HOLD for investigation.
